## Current

::: {.cv-row}
[Oct 2026–present]{.cv-date}

::: {}
**[Machine Learning for Human Genetics](https://www.cs.cit.tum.de/cmm/training-and-teaching/winter-term-2026/computational-modeling-for-system-genetics/)**\
Lectures, coding tutorials and a supervised research project on the statistical and machine learning models used in human and systems genetics. Successor of *Computational Modelling for System Genetics*.
:::
:::

::: {.cv-row}
[Oct 2026–present]{.cv-date}

::: {}
**[A Practical Introduction to Data Science](https://www.cs.cit.tum.de/cmm/training-and-teaching/winter-term-2026/a-practical-introduction-to-data-science/)**\
Methods and good practices of data science in Python: getting and structuring data, visualization, statistical testing and supervised learning.
:::
:::

## Past

::: {.cv-row}
[Oct 2022–Apr 2026]{.cv-date}

::: {}
**[Computational Modelling for System Genetics](https://www.cs.cit.tum.de/cmm/training-and-teaching/winter-term-2025/computational-modelling-for-system-genetics/)**\
Lectures and tutorials introducing systems genetics and its statistical and AI models, followed by a hands-on research project.
:::
:::

::: {.cv-row}
[Oct 2022–Apr 2026]{.cv-date}

::: {}
**[Data Analysis and Visualization in R](https://www.cs.cit.tum.de/cmm/training-and-teaching/winter-term-2025/data-analysis-and-visualization-in-r/)**\
Methods and good practices of data science: tidying data, visualization, unsupervised learning, statistical testing and supervised learning.
:::
:::

::: {.cv-row}
[Apr 2023–Oct 2025]{.cv-date}

::: {}
**[Machine Learning for Regulatory Genomics](https://www.cs.cit.tum.de/cmm/training-and-teaching/summer-term-2026/machine-learning-for-regulatory-genomics/)**\
